executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: dietary cost per resident day ($57.46) was 195% of the Connecticut median ($29.51). Ask what drove the higher dietary cost (contracts, supplies, staffing or a one-time expense).
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $179.29 per resident day (39.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $2,465,088 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 8,554 Medicaid days, $288.18 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $259.72 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $274.34 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 8.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,171,228, $57.46 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $652,930 (55.7%), allocated fringe $131,843 (11.3%), non-wage costs $386,455 (33.0%). Raw food was $247,260 ($12.13 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $86,272.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $323,918, $15.89 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $224,756 (69.4%), allocated fringe $45,384 (14.0%), non-wage costs $53,778 (16.6%).

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 14 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $188,676 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Assistant Administrator (page 10 line A3), removed $132,719; Other Professional Care Of Residents (page 10 line A12o), removed $107,887; Other Administrative Salaries (page 10 line A4), added $106,077. Separately, the home itself removed $701,005 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
